description: Set or replace subtitles (WebVTT) of a YouTube video for one language. Source: vtt text, an https URL, or the library entry's subtitles (library_slug).

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

library_slug.description: Slug of the library entry whose subtitles are used

url.description: https URL of a WebVTT file

name: set_youtube_captions
